faq.a0: Nailfolio helps you manage your work gallery, connect with clients by QR code, receive their Inspiration Sessions and talk in Messages. Paid plans also include client visit history. The app works in a phone browser.
faq.q1: How does Nailfolio differ from an Instagram gallery?
faq.a1: In Nailfolio, your client browses your work with color, style and length filters. Once connected, she can select photos and share an Inspiration Session with a note. Paid plans also include visit history.
faq.a2: With Free Demo, you can add up to 5 photos and connect with up to 2 clients. See the pricing page for paid-plan details.
faq.q3: What does the client get after scanning the QR code?
faq.a3: After signing in, your client sends a connection request. You approve it with one tap, so you control access to your full gallery with color, style and length filters. Once connected, she can browse your work, like designs and send you an Inspiration Session before the visit.
faq.q4: What about my photos: who owns them?
faq.a4: You retain the rights to your photos. Nailfolio does not sell them or use them in ads. After closing your account, you have 90 days to restore it along with your photos.
faq.q5: How do I set up a portfolio?
faq.a5: Create an account, add photos and tag color, style and length. Then show your QR code to your client and approve her connection request.

Every instance of a paired Stylist viewing a Client's contact data is recorded in the ContactAccessLog system.

Recorded information: Stylist identifier, Client identifier, date and time of access, type of data viewed.

Purpose: ensuring accountability in accordance with Art. 5(2) GDPR. Clients have the right to obtain information about who accessed their contact data and when.
contactAccessLog.title: 9. ContactAccessLog, Access Audit Trail

cookies.content:
User sessions are managed via HTTP headers (header-based authentication), not traditional cookies. This is due to the app architecture running as a WebView in mobile applications.

Browser localStorage stores the authentication token and user interface preferences (e.g., selected color theme and language).

We use Google Tag Manager to manage and load our analytics scripts. We run analytics tools (PostHog, as well as Google Analytics 4 loaded via Google Tag Manager and Microsoft Clarity) only after you give consent in the cookie banner (details in the data sharing section). We do not use advertising cookies and do not share data with advertising companies.
cookies.title: 12. Cookies and Tracking Technologies

dataCollection.content:
We collect the following personal data:

Data provided during registration: email address (required), name or display name (required for Stylists), phone number (optional), city (required for Stylists).

Data optionally provided in the profile: business or salon name, address (street, postal code, country), website, booking link, Instagram link.

Technical data collected automatically: IP address, browser type (user agent), device type, session data (token, expiry time).

Approximate city for a connection request: derived automatically from the IP address by Cloudflare.

Nail art photos: uploaded by Stylists to their gallery. Photos should not contain faces or identifying information, see section 5.

Client contact data (optional): phone number and contact email visible only to paired Stylists.

In-app messages: the content of correspondence between a paired Stylist and Client in Messages (one thread per pair), and the content of support requests to Nailfolio. Using Messages is optional. Messages are included in the right to data portability (GDPR Art. 20).

VAT invoice details (optional, only at checkout): company name, address and tax ID (NIP). We store them only with Stripe, not in the Nailfolio database.
dataCollection.title: 2. What Data We Collect
dataCollection.callout: We only collect data essential to running Nailfolio. We never sell it or share it with advertising companies.

dataRetention.content:
General principle: we retain data no longer than necessary for the purposes of processing and for the periods required by law.

Active account data: retained for the entire duration of service use.

Data after account closure: for 90 days the account remains restorable (recovery) by logging back in. After 90 days the account is permanently closed and access expires. You may request data erasure at any time (Art. 17 GDPR), which we carry out subject to legal obligations (e.g. the obligation to retain billing data).

Billing data: retained for the period required by tax law (5 years from the end of the year in which the transaction occurred).

Inspiration Session data: a session stays in the stylist’s active list for __NF_SESSION_EXPIRY_DAYS__ days after sharing. Expiry does not automatically delete all history; further storage follows account permissions and data-retention rules.

Event log: retained in accordance with the Controller's retention policy (up to 12 months).

In-app messages and support requests: retained until the account is deleted, subject to the 90-day recovery window.

VAT invoice details: only with Stripe, in line with tax requirements (see billing data above).
dataRetention.title: 10. Data Retention

dataSharing.content:
Your data may be shared with the following data processors:

Stripe (payment processor, USA, EU-US DPF): email address and data necessary for payment processing. Stripe acts as an independent data controller, see Stripe's privacy policy for details.

Resend (email delivery, primary provider, USA, EU-US DPF): email address for delivering transactional messages and notifications.

Mailgun (email delivery, fallback provider, USA, EU-US DPF): email address for delivering messages when delivery via the primary provider fails.

Cloudinary (image hosting, USA, EU-US DPF): photos uploaded to gallery for storage and optimization.

Neon (database, USA, EU-US DPF): account, gallery, and activity data for service delivery.

Render (application hosting, USA, EU-US DPF): data processed on servers for service delivery.

Cloudflare (CDN and protection, USA, EU-US DPF): technical connection data for attack protection and content delivery optimization. Cloudflare also derives an approximate city from the IP address for connection requests.

Google Tag Manager (tag management, USA, EU-US DPF): managing and loading analytics scripts (including Google Analytics 4). Loaded only if you consent via the cookie banner.

Google Analytics 4 (web analytics, loaded via Google Tag Manager, USA, EU-US DPF): anonymized IP address, page views, and usage events for product improvement. Only if you consent via the cookie banner.

Microsoft Clarity (UX analytics, USA, EU-US DPF): anonymized session recordings, heatmaps, and click data for interface improvement. Only if you consent via the cookie banner.

PostHog (product analytics, USA; data stored in the EU (Frankfurt), under Standard Contractual Clauses, SCC): usage events, heatmaps, and session recordings with form fields masked and sensitive URL parameters redacted, for product improvement. Only if you consent via the cookie banner.

We do not sell your personal data. We do not share data with advertising companies. We do not profile users for marketing purposes.

Data may be disclosed to law enforcement or courts pursuant to applicable law.

We process data on the following legal bases (Art. 6(1) GDPR):

Performance of a contract (Art. 6(1)(b)): processing necessary to provide the service, registration, gallery management, uploading and displaying photos, QR connections with clients, Messages, support requests, payments.

Consent (Art. 6(1)(a)): providing optional contact and profile data, cookie/analytics consents (PostHog, Google Tag Manager, Google Analytics 4, Microsoft Clarity), and marketing/newsletter consents.

Legitimate interest of the Controller (Art. 6(1)(f)): Platform security, abuse prevention, internal analytics, enforcement of claims.

Legal obligation (Art. 6(1)(c)): retention of billing data in accordance with tax regulations.

photoRules.content:
Photos uploaded to the gallery should depict nail art exclusively. It is prohibited to upload photos containing faces, identity documents, or other identifying information.

Nail art photos do NOT constitute biometric data within the meaning of Art. 9 GDPR. We do not process photos for the purpose of identifying individuals.

The copyright owner of the photos is the Stylist who uploaded them. The Controller processes photos solely to display them in Nailfolio in accordance with the license granted in the Terms of Service.

Photos are stored with the provider Cloudinary (USA) on the basis of the EU-US Data Privacy Framework (EU-US DPF) adequacy decision; see Section 8 for details. After you close your account, photos remain available throughout the 90-day account recovery period. You may request permanent erasure of your photos at any time (Art. 17 GDPR).
photoRules.title: 5. Photos: Special Rules

processingPurposes.content:
We process your data for the following purposes:

Service delivery: account registration, authentication (Google, magic link), gallery management, QR pairing, Session Share, Staff Accounts, Messages between a paired Stylist and Client, support requests.

Communication: system notifications (e.g. session expiry, changes to the terms), transactional emails (registration confirmation, plan changes, a new message in Messages).

Security: session monitoring, abuse detection, logging access to contact data (ContactAccessLog), protection against unauthorized access.

Internal analytics: anonymous usage statistics (number of accounts, activity, plan distribution). We do not profile users for advertising purposes.

The approximate city helps the Stylist recognise a connection request. It does not establish the Client’s home address.
processingPurposes.title: 3. Processing Purposes

qrPairing.content:
During QR pairing, the following data is exchanged: the Stylist account identifier, the Client account identifier, and the pairing date.

After connecting, the Client gains access to the Stylist’s photo gallery, display name, city and contact details (if provided). In an active salon, she also gains access to the galleries of all contributing members and can contact each of them. Browsing the salon gallery alone does not disclose the Client’s data to those members; a connection with a given Stylist is created on the first successfully sent message or shared inspiration session.

The Stylist gains access to: the Client's name and contact details (if the Client provided them in their profile). Every time a Stylist accesses a Client's contact data is recorded in the ContactAccessLog system.

The Client can revoke pairing in the app settings, which immediately cuts off the Stylist's access to their data.

When a connection is requested, the Stylist also sees the Client’s profile photo, if available, an optional message and an approximate city, if it can be determined. Cloudflare automatically derives the city from the IP address. A missing location or a lookup failure never prevents sending the request. The approximate city is not a place of residence and may be inaccurate.

When the request is accepted, the city and message are copied to the note in the Client’s card, where they remain until edited or deleted under the account data retention rules. If the request is declined or withdrawn, its city and message are deleted.
qrPairing.title: 6. QR and Pairing, Data Exchange

sessionShare.content:
The Session Share feature lets a client share selected gallery photos directly with a stylist. The Client selects a Stylist with whom she is directly connected or whom she can access through an active salon, and sends selected photos from the galleries available to her. She may add one note to each inspiration session.

Shared photos are available in the Stylist's Session Clipboard for __NF_SESSION_EXPIRY_DAYS__ days from the moment of sharing.

After __NF_SESSION_EXPIRY_DAYS__ days, the session leaves the stylist’s active list. Expiry does not mean all history is deleted. Further storage follows account permissions and the data-retention rules described in this policy.
sessionShare.title: 7. Session Share, Temporary Data

userRights.content:
Under the GDPR, you have the following rights:

Right of access (Art. 15): you may obtain information about what personal data we process.

Right to rectification (Art. 16): you may request correction of inaccurate data.

Right to erasure (Art. 17): you may request data erasure at any time by contacting the Controller (__NF_CONTACT_privacy__). We carry it out subject to legal obligations. Closing your account in the app settings is a separate feature: for 90 days the account remains restorable, and after that period it is permanently closed.

Right to data portability (Art. 20): you may request a copy of your data in a machine-readable format.

Right to object (Art. 21): you may object to processing based on legitimate interest.

Right to restriction of processing (Art. 18): you may request restriction of processing in certain situations.

Right to withdraw consent: you may withdraw your consent to data processing at any time. Withdrawal does not affect the lawfulness of processing carried out before the withdrawal.

Right to lodge a complaint: you have the right to lodge a complaint with the President of the Personal Data Protection Office (UODO), ul. Stawki 2, 00-193 Warsaw, Poland, www.uodo.gov.pl.
userRights.title: 11. Your Rights

definitions.content:
Platform, the Nailfolio web application available at nailfolio.app and as a mobile app, enabling nail stylists to showcase their portfolio and clients to browse inspiration.

Service Provider, __PII_FIRMA__, NIP: __PII_NIP__, registered at: __PII_ADRES__, Poland.

Stylist, a user with a STYLIST account who builds a nail design gallery and manages relationships with clients.

Client, a user with a CLIENT account who browses stylist galleries, saves favorite designs, and uses the pairing feature.

Account, an individual user account on the Platform, created by registering via Google or email address (magic link). A single user may hold both a Stylist account and a Client account at the same time.

Gallery, a collection of nail design photos uploaded by a Stylist, tagged with colors, style traits, and nail length.

QR Connection, a mechanism for linking a Client account with a Stylist account: the Client scans the Stylist's permanent QR code and sends a connection request, which the Stylist accepts.

Session Share, a feature for a Client to share photos with a connected Stylist. The Client selects a Stylist with whom she is directly connected or whom she can access through an active salon, and sends selected photos from the galleries available to her. Sharing takes place remotely. Photos remain available in the Stylist's Session Clipboard for __NF_SESSION_EXPIRY_DAYS__ days after sharing.

Staff Account, salon team membership available on Studio and Scale plans. The owner invites a person by email address. The invited person signs in normally and creates a Stylist account if she does not already have one. The invitation acceptance link does not sign her in. After acceptance, that person's name and photo appear in the team list. Membership gives access to the shared salon gallery, without access to other Stylists’ private clients, notes or conversations.

galleryRules.content:
The gallery is intended solely for displaying nail design photos. It is prohibited to upload photos containing: faces of people, identity documents, offensive or illegal content, or content unrelated to nail design.

The Stylist tags each photo with colors (1-3), style traits (at least 1), and nail length (short, medium, long, XL). Tags let clients filter the gallery.

Gallery photo limits depend on the pricing plan: Free Demo plan, up to 5 photos, Pro plan and higher, unlimited. Once the limit is reached, the Stylist cannot add new photos without deleting older ones or moving to a higher plan.

The Stylist may pin selected photos to the top of the gallery (pinned). The number of pinned photos depends on the plan: Free Demo plan up to 3, Pro plan up to 10, Pro Marka plan up to 15, Studio plan up to 30, Scale plan up to 50. Pinned photos are visible on the Stylist's public profile and appear first in the gallery.

Colors and style traits are defined globally by the Platform administrator, the Stylist cannot add her own tags.

plansPayments.content:
Clients use the Platform free of charge. Pricing plans apply only to Stylist accounts.

Available plans: Free Demo (free, up to 5 photos, up to 2 paired clients), Pro (paid, unlimited photos and clients), Pro Marka (paid, expanded pinned photo and public profile limits, no staff accounts), Studio (paid, like Pro Marka plus the ability to invite members to a salon team), Scale (custom, for large salons).

Payments are handled by the external provider Stripe. The Platform does not store payment card data. Plan changes are available in the app. Subscription cancellation and access to invoices are handled through the Stripe customer portal.

A __NF_TRIAL_DAYS__-day free trial is available for the Pro, Pro Marka, and Studio plans. Starting the trial requires entering a payment card in Stripe. When the trial ends, the subscription automatically moves to the chosen paid plan unless the user cancels during the trial period.

Moving to a higher plan takes effect immediately. Moving to a lower plan takes effect at the start of the next billing period. After a subscription is canceled, the account stays active until the end of the paid period.
plansPayments.title: 6. Plans and Payments

qrPairing.content:
A QR Connection gives a Client access to the Stylist’s full gallery and, in an active salon, to the galleries of all members contributing their work, with the ability to contact each of them. Every Stylist has a permanent QR code in the app that leads to her public profile. The code can be printed, shown on a phone screen or shared as a link.

The Client scans the code, signs in to her account and sends a connection request. The request alone does not give access to the full gallery. The Stylist can accept or decline the request, and the Client can cancel it until it has been decided. Once the request is accepted, a permanent connection is created between the Stylist and Client accounts, and the Client gains access to the full gallery, filters, and the ability to save favorite designs.

The limit of three connections applies only to the Client’s direct connections with Stylists; connections obtained through a salon do not count towards this limit. Once the limit is reached, the Client must end one of the connections to add a new one.

Connected Client limits for Stylists depend on the plan: Free Demo plan, up to 2 clients, Pro plan and above, unlimited.

The Stylist can end the connection with a Client at any time. In such case, the Client loses access to the full gallery, open inspiration sessions are closed, and her favorite designs from that gallery are deleted, except designs pinned on the Stylist's public profile.
qrPairing.title: 4. QR Connection

registration.content:
Using the Platform requires being at least 16 years old. People under 16 may not register an account on the Platform on their own. By registering an account, the user confirms that they are at least 16 years old (Art. 8 GDPR).

Registration on the Platform is done with a Google account or an email address (magic link). No password is required.

During the first steps, the user chooses their role: Stylist or Client. The chosen account type is fixed and cannot be changed, but the user can activate the second account type in settings (the dual-account architecture described below).

A single user may hold both a Stylist account and a Client account at the same time (dual-account architecture). The second account type can be activated in account settings. Switching between roles is done with a toggle in the app menu.

During the first steps, the Stylist provides: a publicly visible display name, a city, and optionally a phone number. The Client goes through simplified first steps (a welcome and accepting the terms).

The user is required to provide truthful information. Accounts created for abuse, spam, or breaking the terms may be suspended or deleted.

Each user can log in from several devices at the same time (multi-session). The list of active sessions is available in account settings.
registration.title: 2. Registration and Accounts

sessionShare.content:
Session Share lets a Client share selected gallery photos directly with a Stylist. The Client selects a Stylist with whom she is directly connected or whom she can access through an active salon, and sends selected photos from the galleries available to her. Sharing happens remotely, the physical presence of both parties is not required. The Client may add one note to each inspiration session.

Shared photos appear in the Stylist's Session Clipboard and remain available for __NF_SESSION_EXPIRY_DAYS__ days from the moment of sharing, after which they are removed automatically.

A Client can share at most 3 inspiration sessions with the same Stylist within one hour. The limit applies separately to each Stylist and does not depend on the plan.
sessionShare.title: 5. Session Share

staffAccounts.content:
Salon teams are available on Studio and Scale. The owner may invite any person by email.

Invitations may be accepted from the email link or in the app. The link does not sign anyone in. The invited person signs in normally and creates a Stylist account if she does not already have one. An accepted member uses the salon owner’s active paid plan capabilities on her own account while both membership and that plan continue. Membership makes works available in the shared salon gallery with their author identified. Contribution is enabled by default; each member may turn it off. Each Stylist’s clients, notes and messages remain private. Leaving the team or ending the salon plan removes access through the salon; turning off contribution removes the member’s works from the salon gallery. The member’s own works and direct connections remain on her account. The owner may show the team on the salon public profile at /s/[slug], and each member may opt out of being listed.

The account owner bears full responsibility for actions performed by employees through Staff Accounts. The Service Provider is not responsible for disputes between the account owner and employees.
staffAccounts.title: 7. Staff Accounts (Employee Accounts)

termination.content:
The user may close their account at any time in the app settings. After closure, the account stays restorable (recovery) for 90 days. After 90 days from closure, self-service restoration expires and the account is permanently closed. We retain data only to the extent required by legal obligations, in line with the Privacy Policy.

Within 90 days of closing the account, the user may restore it along with all data (photos, pairings, settings) by logging in again and confirming the restoration.

The user can obtain permanent erasure of their data at any time by submitting a data erasure request (Art. 17 GDPR) to __NF_CONTACT_privacy__. We fulfill the request subject to legal obligations (for example the duty to keep billing data). Data retention rules are described in the Privacy Policy.

The Service Provider reserves the right to suspend or close a user's account in the event of terms violations, actions harmful to the Platform, or harm to other users.

withdrawalRight.content:
Pursuant to Article 27 of the Polish Consumer Rights Act of 30 May 2014, consumers and sole traders (JDG) have the right to withdraw from a distance contract within 14 days without giving any reason.

The right of withdrawal does not apply to the supply of digital content not supplied on a tangible medium, for which the consumer is obliged to pay a price, where performance has begun with the consumer's express prior consent, the consumer has acknowledged that the right of withdrawal is thereby lost, and the trader has provided contract confirmation on a durable medium (Article 38(13) in conjunction with Article 21 of the Consumer Rights Act). For a digital service started before the end of the withdrawal period, the rules on payment for services performed up to withdrawal apply if the user expressly requested the start of performance before that period expired (Article 35 of the Consumer Rights Act).

For paid subscriptions (Pro, Pro Marka, Studio, Scale), the service commences upon subscription activation or activation of a trial requiring a payment card. By accepting these Terms and starting a paid subscription or such trial in Stripe, the user consents to the commencement of service before the expiry of the 14-day withdrawal period and acknowledges the consequences of such commencement. reviews.consentNote: Reviews from stylists and clients who tested Nailfolio, published with their consent.
reviews.sMemory: How many times did I dig through old messages just to remember what I did for her last time. In Nailfolio I pin a gallery to each client. Before the appointment I check her history and preferences, and I already know where to start. The client memory alone is worth the subscription.
reviews.sQr: The QR code is a real winner for me. Clients hate coming up with new passwords, and here they scan the code, sign in with one tap through Google, and have my work on their phone. I show it to them right in the chair and they browse on their own. The app is light and simple. The only thing I miss is the option to add my own logo to the gallery page, to make it feel more like mine.
reviews.sTeam: I run a salon with two other girls, and before, whenever a client moved from one of us to another, we explained everything from scratch. The shared gallery and client history on the Studio plan fixed that completely. The monthly cost for a salon is really very little to me, considering that what we know about a client stays with us instead of leaving with the stylist.
reviews.sFilters: My favorite part is the smart filters. I lost count of how many times a client came in with a Pinterest photo of gel on a short nail bed, while she has long almond nails and wants exactly that. Filtering by length and technique settles it in five minutes, the client only sees what I can actually do for her. My consultations got twice as short.
reviews.sSessions: Inspiration sessions are a feature I did not know I needed, and now I do not work without them. The client gathers designs before the visit, adds notes, and I get a ready plan. No more 'maybe I will come up with something on the spot', I know what she is coming for and I have it saved in her history. Zero commission is a huge plus too, because in my previous app I used to hand over a cut of every new client. Here I pay a fixed amount and have peace of mind.
reviews.sPrice: The free plan is great to start with, to get the idea, but my client limit would run out fast. I like that this is not yet another booking calendar competing with Booksy, but something completely different, a dedicated portfolio. I recommend it, especially to beginners, so they learn good order from day one.
reviews.sAesthetic: I invest a lot in aesthetics, and it annoyed me that my best work disappeared in the Instagram algorithm, a new client only saw what the algorithm fed her. Nailfolio gives me control over what the client sees first, and my work looks much better here than in the grid. I miss the option to reorder photos by hand to put a highlight on top, but otherwise it makes a great impression.
reviews.sWeb: A useful app. I like the smart filters most, and the fact that the portfolio remembers what I did for whom, clients are surprised when I show them the QR. One thing though: I really miss a desktop version. Sometimes I prefer to arrange the gallery on a big screen rather than on my phone. It is still worth it, since you do not take a cut from clients.
reviews.cNoAccount: What I like most is that I do not have to come up with a password. I scan the code at my stylist, sign in with one tap through Google, and have her whole gallery right on my phone. I am tired of setting up accounts with yet another password to remember, and here I just open it and browse. I only miss a 'share with a friend' button to show a design to a friend, but otherwise it is great.
reviews.cMemory: I always forget what color I had three visits ago, and I lose the thread in my messages to the stylist. In Nailfolio I just go back to my history and check. No more texts like 'do you remember that beige from March?'. I recommend it to anyone who, like me, has complete chaos in her head with polish names.
reviews.cPinterest: So many times I came in with an Instagram screenshot and the lady said it could not be done on my nails. In Nailfolio I finally see only what my stylist can really do, no disappointment and no explaining that a design will not work. I can set a filter for short nails and I see right away what I will actually get.
reviews.cSessions: Inspiration sessions are the best thing I have seen. Usually before a visit I collect twenty photos on Instagram and cannot decide. Here I drop a few designs into a session, add a note like 'this base, but with these little gems', and send it to my stylist. She knows what I mean before I even walk in.
reviews.cShy: As a client I am often too shy to say in the salon that a design does not suit me. Thanks to Nailfolio I can calmly browse my stylist's work at home, pick what really fits me, and send it to her before the visit. The stress of the consultation is gone, because everything is settled in advance. I recommend it especially to the shy ones.
reviews.cTime: It cut my decision time at the salon from fifteen minutes to zero, I walk in and already know what we are doing, because I sent the inspiration session a day earlier. I like that it is free for the client and signing in through Google takes literally a moment. I would still love a reminder about an upcoming visit with a preview of the chosen inspiration, but even without it I really enjoy using it.
reviews.cInstagram: I was skeptical, but after testing I changed my mind. Browsing my stylist's work is far more convenient than on Instagram, where I cannot find anything later anyway and the algorithm keeps pushing thousands of other salons at me. Here I have a clean gallery, only her work, and I can filter by color. I love that it is cut off from social media.

story.p1: Photos chosen before a visit help you discuss color, length and nail art. When a client chooses from their stylist’s work, the conversation can refer to designs the stylist has already created.
story.p2: When preparing a nail design, you can filter the gallery by colour or nail length, save a note and check the client’s visit history.

faq.q2: How is Nailfolio different from Booksy?
faq.a2: Booksy is a platform for booking appointments. Nailfolio is a nail portfolio with client history: color, style and length filters, a QR code at the salon, and Inspiration Sessions from clients. They solve different problems, so the two work well side by side.
faq.a3: Nailfolio is developed without external investors. Paid plans fund further app development.
faq.a4: Cloudinary handles photos, and Stripe handles payments. Some providers also process data outside the EU; see the Privacy Policy for details. Nailfolio does not sell data or use marketing cookies.

faq.q01Answer: You can send your stylist a link to the Nailfolio page for stylists. Once they create an account and add a gallery, open their profile from the link and select “Request to connect”.
faq.q01Question: What if my stylist isn't on Nailfolio yet?
faq.q02Answer: Your stylist’s public profile is available without an account. You need a free client account to like it. The full gallery and sharing Inspiration Sessions also require a confirmed connection. Sign in with Google or an email link, without a password.
faq.q02Question: Do I need to create an account?

faq.q05Answer: Open the next stylist’s profile from the link and select “Request to connect”. You can also scan their QR code and send a request.
faq.q06Answer: You do not pay for a client account. It requires no card or subscription.
faq.q07Answer: The quickest way to find your stylist is to scan her QR code at the salon. You can also open your stylist’s public profile from the link she sent you.
faq.q07Question: How do I find a stylist who's already on Nailfolio?
faq.q08Answer: Yes. Sign in as a client and select “Send a message” on the stylist’s profile. You do not need to be connected. If the stylist lists a phone number on her profile, you can also call her.

faq.a1: With the Studio plan, you can invite up to {count} stylists, in addition to the owner's account. Each person accepts an invitation and uses their own account. While Studio or Scale is active, team members can use its features without an additional subscription.
faq.a2: Yes. Every work in the salon gallery shows the author’s name, avatar and profile link. Clients can also filter to one stylist’s work.
faq.a3: Yes, members can browse the shared salon gallery. Each edits and deletes only her own photos. Only you choose the showcase at the top of the salon profile.
faq.a4: See the pricing page for the current price. Studio includes up to 10 accounts including yours, a salon dashboard and a shared salon profile. Contact us about Scale for a larger team.
faq.a5: Yes, you can cancel on the Plan page. When the paid plan ends, the salon gallery and profile become unavailable and stylists return to their own plans. Photos and direct client connections stay in their accounts; salon-derived connections end.
faq.a6: Her work leaves the salon gallery and showcase, but remains in her account with clients directly connected to her. Salon-derived connections end. She returns to her own plan without deleting photos. Clients keep salon access if they also have a direct connection with another team member.
faq.a7: You can try Studio under the trial terms shown in pricing. Team members receive plan capabilities on their own accounts when the salon subscription is an active paid subscription.

faq.a3: Features such as the gallery and Inspiration Sessions require an internet connection. Nailfolio has no offline mode.
faq.q4: Does the app collect data for advertising?

faq.a5: Nailfolio runs in your phone's browser; you do not need to install an app.
faq.q6: Does the client have to install the app?
faq.a6: Clients can use Nailfolio in their phone’s browser. An account is needed for likes and Inspiration Sessions, and a confirmed connection with the stylist gives access to the full gallery. Sign-in uses Google or an email link. The stylist’s public profile is available without an account.
faq.q7: Can I use Nailfolio as a client, without a stylist account?
faq.a7: Yes. You can use a free client account without creating a stylist account. You can also have both.
faq.q8: What happens when I change my phone?
faq.a8: On a new device, sign in with the same email address. You can use Nailfolio on several devices, such as a phone and a tablet.

general.a1: Nailfolio is an app for nail stylists and their clients. It includes a gallery with filters, QR connections, Inspiration Sessions, Messages and a client card with visit history.
general.a2: Stylists can start with Free Demo without a card: up to 5 photos, up to 2 connected clients and 3 pinned styles. Free Demo does not expire. Pro includes an unlimited gallery and client list, plus 90 days of visit history; compare the other paid plans on the pricing page. The __NF_TRIAL_DAYS__-day trial is available once per account and requires a card at activation. After __NF_TRIAL_DAYS__ days, the subscription starts unless you cancel first. A client account is free.
general.a3: A stylist or client opens nailfolio.app in a phone browser on Android or iPhone and signs in with Google or an email link.
general.a4: Stylists and clients can use all Nailfolio features in a phone browser on Android and iPhone. There is no separate desktop app. The Android app is in preparation.
general.a5: Connections to the app are encrypted. Stripe handles payments. See the Privacy Policy for information about service providers and data processing.
general.a6: A stylist or client can use the contact form, email __NF_CONTACT_contact__ or message @nailfolio on Instagram.
general.a7: A stylist or client signs in with Google or an email link. To receive a link, enter an email address and open the link in the message. No password is needed.
general.a8: A stylist or client should check Spam and Promotions. A sign-in link is valid for one hour; after that, request a new one or sign in with Google. If the problem continues, use the contact form and include the email address used to sign in.
general.a9: A stylist or client can use the same account across all their devices at once. Sign in the same way on each one: with a login link sent to the same email address or with Google. Active sessions can be checked and signed out in the Signed-in devices section of Account.
general.a10: One person can use Nailfolio as both a stylist and a client. In Account, select Settings, then Switch role. Each role keeps its own data, galleries and settings.
general.a11: A stylist or client should close and reopen Nailfolio, then check the internet connection. If the problem continues, send a report with the phone model, operating system and error description.
general.a12: A stylist or client opens the photo menu (three dots), selects “Report” and chooses a reason. The report goes to the moderation team. If a moderator takes action on the photo and the author's email address is available, the author receives the decision by email. The person who submitted the report does not receive an outcome notification.

stylists.a1: Open the app, go to the Add tab, take a photo or choose from your gallery, tag colors and features, then publish.
stylists.a2: Pinned photos are your best work, displayed at the top of your public profile. The number of pins depends on your plan.
stylists.a3: You have one permanent QR code on the Connection screen. Show it to your client on your phone or print it and display it at your station. Your client scans it, opens your profile and sends a connection request for you to accept.
stylists.a4: Your client creates an Inspiration Session, chooses photos from your gallery, adds one note and shares the collection with you in one tap. You will find it in the Session Inbox.
stylists.a5: Open Your account and plan, then Plan. Before changing a paid plan, you will see the amount and billing consequences. The change takes effect after the displayed difference is settled. If you switch to Free Demo, your current plan remains active until the end of the paid period.
stylists.a6: Choose Studio and invite stylists by email. After accepting and signing in normally, they use the active salon plan’s capabilities in their own accounts. Their work joins the shared gallery with author credits; each can turn this off in her profile. A client connected with one member can browse the whole gallery and contact any contributing stylist. You can display your permanent QR code at reception as the salon’s code: once you accept the request, the client can see the work of all team members who share photos with the salon and message each of them.
stylists.a7: Your photos and data stay in your account, and connected clients retain access to the full gallery. After a paid plan ends, the public profile shows up to 3 pinned styles, and Free Demo blocks adding photos beyond 5 or connecting more than 2 clients. Nothing is deleted.
stylists.a8: After the __NF_TRIAL_DAYS__-day trial, your subscription renews automatically. Manage your plan in account settings.
stylists.a9: Open Your account and plan, then Plan and subscription management. You can cancel renewal in the Stripe portal. Your current plan remains active until the end of the paid period, then Free Demo limits apply. Your account, data and photos remain, and connected clients keep access to the gallery.
stylists.a10: Check that your card is active and has sufficient funds. Go to Account → Subscription → Manage subscription and update your card details. Stripe will automatically retry the payment. If the problem persists, use the contact form.
stylists.a11: During the __NF_TRIAL_DAYS__-day Pro trial, you can cancel your subscription at no charge. If you have already been charged, submit a request within 14 days. After it has been reviewed, you will receive a response about the refund.
stylists.a12: The owner can remove a stylist, and a member can leave. The stylist returns to their own plan’s capabilities. Photos and client data stay on their account, but adding beyond their own plan’s limits is blocked.
